doc.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Wrap-up, 'unsoundmen' and Dick Wellstood on creating your own energy
summary: Davern jokes about soundmen supplying energy, recalling Wellstood's advice to create your own.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Just a mere bag of shells. You’re a ball to talk with. I’m sorry I rambled on so much. I think you must have had more cogent things to ask me.
No, I didn’t actually. I was going to ask you about your fondness for soundmen but—
That’s why there’s no energy anymore.
Oh, no one has to put out.
But if they’re not putting out someone like puts it out for them.
“Don’t worry, you just stand and play your horn.” Come on. No energy. I know that Wellstood, used to do one of these, and when I’d come in he’d go — and I finally said, © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
“What are you doing?” He says, “Oh, what, you want me to provide the energy for you?” He says, “Create your own fucking energy, mother fucker.”

But he managed to do that anyway. He knew better than that. It was a joint effort. You don’t pull the thing out from underneath you — you do this — then he’d stop and he’d say “you got it.” That’s not fair. It wouldn’t be right at all. All right.
